about: Public C# surface of the creator SDK (BS.SDK, BS.SDK.Splines, Banter.VisualScripting): types, members, serialized field names and VS unit ports. Removals and changes fail SdkSurfaceTests; additions are reported. Regenerate deliberately: copy Temp/BridgeSurface/bs-sdk-surface.current.json over this file after an EditMode run, or run Tests/Editor/Surface/Generator~ (see Program.cs).
generatedFrom: 2026-11-05 working tree of the creator SDK (submodule feature/sdk-back-end at c6e9ed2e plus uncommitted changes; BS.SDK from an rsp compile of the working tree, the other assemblies from Library/ScriptAssemblies). Versus the 2026-11-03 baseline: removes BatchUpdater and BS.WireFrame (the legacy lane is gone) and adds what World Option and the rest added since.
